experiences.name: Praia da Marinha Coastal Walk & Swim
experiences.description: Explore one of the Algarve's most stunning beaches, known for its dramatic golden limestone cliffs, sea caves, and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Walk the clifftop trail and descend to the secluded cove for a swim.

experiences.name: Algarve Wine & Cheese Tasting Tour
experiences.description: Join a guided tasting session at a local Algarve winery such as Quinta dos Vales, sampling regional wines including Negra Mole and Arinto varieties paired with local cheeses and charcuterie. Learn about the unique terroir of southern Portugal.

experiences.name: Benagil Sea Cave Kayak Tour
experiences.description: Paddle by kayak through the iconic Benagil Cave, one of the world's most beautiful sea caves accessible only from the water. A guided tour takes you through hidden grottos and along the dramatic coastline with stunning rock formations.

experiences.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise with Wine
experiences.description: Sail along the Algarve coastline aboard a catamaran at golden hour, enjoying complimentary local wines and snacks while watching the sun dip below the Atlantic. The cruise passes sea caves, arches, and secluded beaches.

experiences.name: Praia de Meia Praia Beach Day
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed day at one of the Algarve's longest and most beautiful sandy beaches stretching over 4 km. Rent a sun lounger, enjoy fresh seafood at a beachside restaurant, and take a dip in the calm Atlantic waters.
